moved.sentence: **session-mode-fallback**: Use **session mode** only when the workload genuinely needs session-scoped features (below) and you accept near-1:1 client-to-server connection mapping.

judged.note: Session mode only when session-scoped features are genuinely needed and near-1:1 mapping is accepted is kept at SHOULD with both conditions; '(below)' now points at the transaction-mode rules.

moved.sentence: **disable-driver-side-prepare**: When unsure of pooler support, configure the driver/ORM to avoid named server-side prepared statements (e.g. set query/plan caching off, or use a pooler-aware setting) and rely on `SET LOCAL` for per-request GUCs.

judged.note: When unsure of pooler support, avoiding named server-side prepared statements and relying on SET LOCAL is kept at SHOULD with its condition and examples.

moved.sentence: **size-the-pool**: Set the pooler's server pool (`default_pool_size`) below `max_connections` with headroom for migrations, admin, and direct connections.

judged.note: Setting default_pool_size below max_connections with headroom for migrations, admin and direct connections is kept at SHOULD with all three headroom uses.

moved.sentence: **fail-fast-on-exhaustion**: Configure short client-side connection acquisition timeouts so an exhausted pool surfaces a fast, observable error rather than hanging requests.

judged.note: Short client-side acquisition timeouts so an exhausted pool fails fast and observably is kept at SHOULD with its reason.

moved.sentence: Code that runs under transaction-mode pooling **MUST NOT** depend on:

judged.note: The lead-in's MUST NOT is kept in each of the five rules it introduced, each opening 'Code that runs under transaction-mode pooling MUST NOT depend on'; rationale keeps the framing and its reason.
No dependence on session-level SET/RESET of GUCs is kept at MUST NOT with every example and the SET LOCAL alternative.
No dependence on LISTEN/NOTIFY is kept at MUST NOT with its reason and both alternatives.
No dependence on session-level advisory locks is kept at MUST NOT with the pg_advisory_xact_lock alternative and its reason.

moved.sentence: **no-temp-tables**: Session-scoped temporary tables and `WITH HOLD` cursors that outlive a transaction.

judged.note: No dependence on session temp tables and WITH HOLD cursors is kept at MUST NOT.
No dependence on text-mode PREPARE/DEALLOCATE is kept at MUST NOT; the PgBouncer version nuance is kept in rationale.

moved.sentence: Verify your pooler version and that your driver uses the extended protocol, not text-mode `PREPARE`.

judged.note: Verifying the pooler version and that the driver uses the extended protocol, not text-mode PREPARE, is kept at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Confirm against your deployed pooler's docs.

judged.note: Confirming against the deployed pooler's docs is kept at SHOULD in the same rule.

moved.sentence: Run the app's full transaction set against a transaction-mode pooler in staging; assert no `prepared statement does not exist` / `InvalidSqlStatementName` errors under concurrency.

judged.note: The staging run of the full transaction set against a transaction-mode pooler, asserting no prepared-statement errors under concurrency, is kept at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Grep the codebase for `SET ` (non-`LOCAL`), `LISTEN`, `pg_advisory_lock(` (non-`_xact_`), and session temp-table usage before deploying behind transaction pooling.

judged.note: The pre-deploy grep for non-LOCAL SET, LISTEN, non-xact pg_advisory_lock and session temp tables is kept at SHOULD with every pattern.
